findings.problem: Founder canon C7 asks for screens over 50% image. Measured at 390px: choice 1.6%, verdict 8.7%, lobby 25.0%, scene 34.8%. Not one screen clears the floor and the two the player sees most are almost pure text. The hand-drawn pass made what art exists excellent, which has masked how little of it there is.
findings.fix: Three moves, cheapest first: card thumbnails on the choice screens (also fixes TEXT-WALL), the house lifted and enlarged on the verdict, and the ink plate persisting as a header band through the three choices so the scene stays on screen while it is being staged.

findings.anchor: .curtain animation, 2.5s + 0.62s delay, plus plate draw to 3.1s
findings.problem: The curtain is the best thing in the build and it is also a toll. Roughly 3 seconds before the scene is readable, paid again on every entry and every NEXT SCENE, with no way past it. Meaningful the first time, furniture by the fourth.
findings.fix: Play it in full on a scene's first visit in a session and drop to a fast 0.6s haul on return visits. The reduced-motion path already proves the instant-open state is legible.
findings.framework: Mayer coherence; motion earns its seconds once
findings.evidence: pullL 2.5s at 0.5s delay; plate d3 delay 3.1s

findings.problem: The studio teal appears exactly once in the entire game, as the registration shadow under the footer spiral. Everywhere else runs amber, the three scene tints and the curtain rose. The mark reads as a sticker from another system rather than the same studio that drew the room.
findings.fix: Either retire the teal from this build and let the mark run orange and cream, or give teal one structural job - the focus ring wants a colour and has none.
